content: Mawari wewiwamete wakemari
»Merikɨte 'a'iwa 'Aruni keneuta'ini meta niwemama Narawi, 'Awihu, 'Eriyatsaxi meta 'Itamaxi. 'Ixaheritsixi watsata mɨkɨ mawari wewiwamete mepɨhɨkɨtɨni.
'A'iwa 'Aruni kamixateya ketineutiwewi mɨpatsietɨka mɨmariwenikɨ 'aixɨa mɨtixeiyariekakɨ.
Ketinewarutaxatɨa temaiwawemete yanemɨtiwarupitɨa, 'Aruni kamixaya memɨtiwewienikɨ 'ixuriki mɨraye'atɨkakɨ, mɨpaɨ 'ana nemɨtipatakɨ nemawari wewiwame mayanikɨ.

»Kemarite pemɨtitiwewieni 'ikɨ pɨtihɨkɨ: kamixa 'etsimɨnena, kuka mekatɨni, kamixa 'emɨtewi, xeime kamixa 'atewime tixukame, hɨiyame meta xupureru. Mɨkɨ kamixate mɨtipatsietɨka 'Aruni pepɨtitiwewirieni meta niwemama nemawari wewiwamete memɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ.
Mɨkɨ pemɨtitiwewienikɨ huru pepuyurieni, meta 'ixuriki mɨyɨtsikimaɨye, kwimɨxeta meta mɨxeta metatsiere rinu 'ixurikiyari.
Kamixa 'etsimɨnena
»Kamixa 'etsimɨnena pɨtaxuire hurukɨ, hiru mɨyɨtsikimaɨyekɨ, kwimɨxetakɨ, mɨxeta meta rinu 'aixɨa mɨ'anekɨ.
Naiparieyatsie pawɨtɨkani ya'atayeyeutɨ, mɨkɨkɨ makuwiwierikenikɨ.
Hɨiyame tixukametsiere, kamixa manuhɨayani, hurukɨ, 'ixuriki mɨyɨtsikimaɨye, kwimɨxeta, mɨxeta, meta rinu 'ixurikiyari 'aixɨa mɨ'ane mɨkɨ naitɨ puyuxewiriyani.
»'Unitse teteyari keneutitɨki hutame, mɨkɨtsie keniwara'utɨa 'Ixaheri niwemama tamamata heimana huta memɨyupaɨme
kememɨteheukunuiwa, xeime tetetsie me'ataxewime keniwareu'utɨa, meta me'ataxewime xeimetsie.
Tetexi witsimɨ'anene mɨtixixiwa, katineu'utɨaxɨamɨkɨ tseyu kemɨtiwewiwa hepaɨ: hurutsie piwetsitɨaxɨani,
hikɨ kamixa 'etsimɨnena wiwierieyatsie kanekayatsaxɨamɨkɨ. Mɨpaɨ 'ana 'Aruni yunaiparitsie puwara'utɨatɨkani 'Ixaheri niwemama, Yawé mɨwara'eriwanikɨ.
Keneutiwewita huru 'etsipepeme 'anuyexaxawame mana pemeiyatsaxɨanikɨ,
meta hutame huru kaunariyari keneutiwewi, huru meukateitsie mawɨrixɨanikɨ.
Mawari wewiwame kukaya
»Tawitsie mieme kuka heitserie mɨtikuxata, pepitawewieni tixukame hurukɨ, hiru mɨyɨtsikimaɨyekɨ, kwimɨxetakɨ, mɨxetakɨ rinu 'aixɨa mɨ'anekɨ, yaxeikɨa rewewiyakame kamixa 'etsimɨnena hepaɨ.
'Ayehutame pepɨyurieni yaxeikɨa heutatetewame, xeitewiyari tsenitimeturuyari 'ayetewime meta xeitewiyari tsenitimeturuyari 'atayeukame.
Pepeiyatsaxɨani naukakɨa tetexi 'anukutetɨkaime witsimɨ'anene. Mexɨakame mukukatsie keneuyatsaxɨa xetamekɨ, taxaɨyemekɨ meta tsiɨraɨyemekɨ mutimerɨkatɨka,
hutariekata, yuawitɨ tsiɨraɨyemekɨ, yuawimekɨ mukutuxie meta tuxamekɨ mutimerɨka,
hairieka miemetsieta, merie xetatɨ taxaɨyemekɨ, tuxamekɨ kapemaɨyemekɨ meta mɨyɨtsikimaɨyekɨ,
naurieka mukukatsieta, taxaɨyetɨ, kwimɨyɨwi meta tsiɨraɨyemekɨ. Hurutsie hatetɨkaime pepeuyatsaxɨani.
Tamamata heimana huta pɨpaɨmeni tetexi, xexuitɨ nuiwaritsie puwa'inɨaritɨni. Xexuime tetetsie 'Ixaheri niwemama tamamata heimana huta memɨyupaɨme mepa'utɨkani tseyu hepaɨ.
»Hurukɨ kuka wiwieriyari keneutiwewi ya'atayeyeume, mukutapierikeni 'awɨtɨkaime.
Kukatsie hutame huru hanirayari kenamanaxɨa tapa mutatsikuritɨkatsie.
Kenawɨtɨaxɨa huru kaunariyari kuka hanirayaritsie.
Huru kaunariyari muhuta mayexaxawa kamixa 'etsimɨnena naiparieyatsie pepekuwiwitɨaxɨani makatɨrekɨ yɨhɨxie.
»Hutameta hanira keneutiwewi, kukatsie hetɨana paitɨ muta'itsikinatɨkatsie kenamanaxɨa kamixa 'etsimɨnenatsie mɨtinakenikɨ.
Yaxeikɨata hutame huru hanirayari keneutiwewi, kamixa 'etsimɨnenatsie kenamanaxɨa naipari hetɨatsie hɨiyame manukuka heima keneuwipaxɨa.
Hanira kuka hetsie mamane kamixa 'etsimɨnena hanirayari hamatɨa pɨhɨire 'ixuriki yuawimekɨ, hɨiyame puwatseiriyani kamixa kuka matɨa muyuwiyanikɨ.
Mɨpaɨ 'Aruni kepauka Muyepatsietsie meutahani yutawitsie pekatɨkɨni, kuka 'aixɨa mɨti'ane mɨtikuxatanikɨ, 'Ixaheri niwemama kememɨtetetewa pɨwara'utɨaka, Yawé muwara'eriwanikɨ.
Tawitsie mieme kuka heitserie mɨtikuxata, muwa pepeikayatsa 'urimi meta tumimi. Mɨpaɨ kepauka 'Aruni Yawé hɨxie meutahani peixeiyani yutawitsie 'ixaheritsixi wa'inɨari.
Hipatɨ kemari mawari wewiwame
»'Ixuriki mɨyɨtsikimaɨye pepɨyurieni kamixa 'etsimɨtewi heima mieme,
hixɨapa hewatitenime mu'u rewatinakeme. Mewatitenitsie 'atatenime, kamixa 'etsimɨtewi kemɨrewewiya hepaɨ, mɨka'ukatsanikenikɨ.
'Ixuriki tenimeyaritsie putuni wita mɨyɨtsikimaɨyekɨ kwimɨxetakɨ, mɨxetakɨ wewiyatɨkaime, meta huru kapanayari 'anayewɨtɨkaime.
Naime 'ixuriki tenimeyaritsie kapana meta wita putuniyari kenatawɨtɨa.
Mɨkɨ 'ixuriki 'Aruni penakatɨkɨni kepauka mɨti'uximayaka, kapana mutitiraurɨkanikɨ kepauka Yawé hɨxie Muyepatsietsie mɨyeyeikani, mɨpaɨ mɨkɨ mɨkamɨnikɨ.
»Huru tepɨayari keneutawewi 'etsitsuikame 'etsiyeume, hetsiena ketina'utɨa tseyu hepaɨ re'ukame: “Mɨpatsie Yawé Hetsie Mieme”.
Keneuwipa mukuretsitsie 'ixuriki yɨtsikimaɨyemekɨ, mɨkɨ hɨxiena tikunanakeme.
Mɨkɨ tepɨa tseyuyari 'Aruni yukanata yakatinemakamɨkɨ, mɨkɨkɨ Yawé naime 'ixaheritsixi wamawari mɨnaki'eriekakɨ, mɨpaɨ 'Aruni 'axamɨti'ane yuhetsie pɨtikuhɨweni kepauka mawari memɨyetuayanitsie.
»Kamixa 'amɨtewi meta mukuretsi rinu 'ixurikiyari pepɨyurieni. Hɨiyame pɨ'itseni witsireukuwewiyatɨ.
'Aruni niwewema kamixa 'amɨtɨtɨ pekaniwatiwewiriemɨkɨ, kuxira meta mukuretsi, mɨkɨ naitɨ witsipɨti'aneneni 'aixɨa memɨtexeiyariekakɨ.
Xɨkari pe'itikemaritɨani 'a'iwa 'Aruni meta niwemama, pepɨwakawirieni hatseiti pemɨwahɨritɨani heitserie memexeiyanikɨ mepatsietɨ mete'aitatɨ nemawari wewiwamete memɨhɨkɨtɨnikɨ.
»Metatsiere weruxi keniwarutiwewiri 'etɨtɨme wateurite mɨnakakɨ meta memayɨhɨayatsie 'atɨkaime.

'Aruni meta niwemama kepauka memeutahaxɨani tukita mɨkɨta mepuyewetɨkani, yatɨni kepauka 'aurawa memɨkɨne 'ɨkwa mawariyari matitaiyarɨwatsie meteta'uximayatake Muyepatsietsie, xɨka mɨpaɨ mekate'uyurieni mekanikwikuni. 'Ikɨ 'aitsika kanihɨkɨtɨni 'Aruni hetsiemieme meta nuiwarimama hetsiena memɨyekɨne.
